description: This file contains utility functions for managing and selecting nodes, including loading node lists, filtering, fallback logic, and resolution of node IDs, within a larger system that interacts with a gateway API.

methods.name: messageFromError
methods.description: Extracts a string message from various error object types.

methods.name: shouldFallbackToPairList
methods.description: Determines if fallback to node pairing list is needed based on error message.

methods.name: loadNodes
methods.description: Loads a list of nodes from the gateway, with fallback to pairing list if necessary.

methods.name: isLocalMacNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is a local Mac node based on platform and nodeId.

methods.name: compareDefaultNodeOrder
methods.description: Comparator for ordering nodes based on connection time and nodeId.

methods.name: selectDefaultNodeFromList
methods.description: Selects a default node from a list based on capability, connection status, and preferences.

methods.name: pickDefaultNode
methods.description: Selects a default 'canvas' capability node with specific fallback and preferences.

methods.name: listNodes
methods.description: Public function to list nodes via gateway.

methods.name: resolveNodeIdFromList
methods.description: Resolves a node ID from a list of nodes based on a query.

methods.name: resolveNodeId
methods.description: Resolves a node ID from gateway based on query.

methods.name: resolveNode
methods.description: Resolves a node object from gateway based on query.
